DB.description: Authoritative household, account, source, audit, and cache-index database.

CACHE.description: Non-authoritative hot cache and WebAuthn challenge storage.

BACKUPS.description: Encrypted backup and export object storage.

JOBS.description: Asynchronous health check, cache refresh, metadata, and backup jobs.

MARSTV_SOURCE_MASTER_KEY.description: Generate a random 32-byte base64url value. Keep it permanently: encrypted source configurations and backups cannot be restored without it.

MARSTV_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN.description: Generate a random one-time value used only to create the first Owner.
